summary: Dream Finders Homes filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, announcing a merger agreement to acquire Beazer Homes USA via its wholly owned subsidiary, Bulldogs Merger Sub. Beazer shareholders will receive $33.50 per share in cash, with Beazer surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. Options and restricted stock awards are cancelled for cash, except certain 2027 fiscal year RSAs assumed by Dream Finders. The deal is structured as a merger, implying a cash consideration and subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. Watch for antitrust clearance and shareholder vote; the risk-arb spread will reflect deal certainty and timing.
